Light day. Week 37 is where derivatives stopped being formal and became a trade, and the four relationships from it are the ones an options interview is built on.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the gamma-theta identity, the hedged profit relationship and the discrete hedging error rate from memory.
- Sketch delta and gamma against moneyness for two maturities without looking.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>35 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Finish anything outstanding from days 253 to 258. The hedging simulator is the piece milestone 8 is built on, so having it produce a clean profit distribution matters more than any single result.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [15 min]{.task-min} Blank page: the five greeks and what each measures, the gamma-theta identity, the hedged profit as a variance gap, and the square-root error rate. Then sketch delta and gamma against moneyness and check against your day 253 plots.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, thirty-seventh sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications and the sevenths.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> A statistics question with a trap: you run an A/B test, it is not significant, and someone asks whether that means there is no effect. Answer properly in ninety seconds, including what you would report instead of a p-value. This gets asked because most candidates say the wrong thing in the first sentence.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> A coding problem: given a stream of prices, implement an online estimator of the exponentially weighted mean and variance in one pass with no stored history. Write it, then say what happens numerically if the decay is very close to one.
:::
:::
